name: Christopher Wells
source:
A young government employee whose job is ensuring the peaceful coexistence of monsters and humans.

Tired of being stuck in what he considers an unimportant bureaucratic position, he requests a transfer to Saint George, the city with the highest population of monsters.

[Edited from [url=http://monstrousloversevn.tumblr.com/characters]official site[/url]]
